Confirm device deletion on device page (#79)

## Summary
- add a delete confirmation dialog before device removal on the Camellia device page
- reuse the shared confirm dialog pattern and existing delete copy

## Testing
- just camellia check

## Manual QA
- open `device-page`
- click a device delete action and confirm a dialog appears before deletion
- cancel the dialog and verify the device remains
- confirm deletion and verify the device is removed
